title: Dean Martin - Walking My Baby Home

lines.l: And they give me the eye, walking my baby back home.
We stop for a while, she gives me a smile, snuggles her head to my chest.
We start into bed, and that's when I get her talcum all over my bed.
After I kind of straighten my tie, she has to borrow my comb.
One kiss then I continue again
You know she's afraid of the dark, so I have to bark right outside of the door until it's light.
She says if I'd try to kiss her so proud, so I dry her tears all through the night.
borrow the car. One kiss, then I continue again, walking my baby back home. Walking
